title: Your visa needs “one final step”
scenario: Two days before departure, a sponsored search result says your travel authorization is incomplete. The page knows the destination and offers “priority validation” if you pay a processing fee in the next hour.

answers.A: Pay the priority fee now, then verify the authorization later so you do not miss the trip.
answers.B: Close the ad and check your authorization on the official government site you type or navigate to yourself.
answers.C: Ask your airline whether your travel authorization appears valid in their check-in system.

explanation: Travel-document anxiety makes paid “fast track” pages persuasive. Only the issuing authority can confirm the document status.
proTip: For visas and entry permits, start with the government—not the ad.
